text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Okay, it's all about positioning from
here... I'll
hold this position for a bit,
and...)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's made a move from the inside! She's
coming
up from the rear!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Not yet. Be patient and go at your own
pace...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: NOW!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Satono Diamond! What an
incredible
burst of acceleration in the
final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond finishes in first place!
This
unbreakable diamond has shattered
the barrier
that stood in her way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Awww yeah! Yesss! YAHOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You did it, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... That gave me goosebumps!
Satono
Diamond's so good!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hah! So that's her true strength! Now I
get why
she was so upset about her
performances at the
Satsuki Sho and
Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd do awesome out there!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (My legs feel so... light...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I did it!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!
choice_data_list: Congratulations on first place! That was a great run!
Congratulations on first place! That was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My legs were so light today! Even now
that I'm
done running, I'm not tired at
all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I finally ran a race I can be satisfied with!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It feels like shackles have been removed
from my
legs!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I feel so light.
Not just my body... my
mind as well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tears begin to trickle from Satono
Diamond's
eyes. And then...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A hoarse, tearful cry echoes through the
runners'
tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whispers of a jinx on the Satono family
date back
before Satono Diamond was
ever born. I can only
imagine the weight
of growing up under such
circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps her declaration not to let the
jinx get the
best of her gave her the
push she needed to
overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's finally free of its shackles.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Sob... Sorry...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
McQueen was right... I was focusing so
much on
the jinx that it was holding me
back.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But I'm okay now. I won't be led astray
again!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to keep running like I did
today and
prove that I can win more G1
races!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's easier said than done!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Congrats on winning the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I won the same race you did last
year! So
now I can hold my head high
and say this...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Face me in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: With pleasure!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's okay with you, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But you'd better prepare yourself! I'm
going to be
on a completely different
level in the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But before we race, I'm going to show
the whole
world the spirit of Japan and
what I can do at the
Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm looking forward to seeing that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And then let's make the Arima Kinen the
best
race we can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from Kyoto
Racecourse...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. My heart hasn't stopped pounding
all
day. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. Even now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking about running against Kita
in the
Arima Kinen gets my blood
pumping. Is this
anticipation, or is it
excitement?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I never thought my silly childhood dream
would
actually come true...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I used to imagine us running a G1
race
together. But it turns out reality is
even more
dramatic.
choice_data_list: A dream about running in a race with Kitasan?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now Kita is the rival standing between
me and my
dream of becoming an
illustrious runner.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This is the most dramatic and exciting
destiny I
could ask for!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It is. Kita has always been ahead of me,
but I'll
surpass her and make my
dream—the Satono
family's
dream—come true.
choice_data_list: What a magnificent stage, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond shows no signs of
hesitation.
The vermilion fire in her eyes
is burning as fiercely
as the time we first
met.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Right! I have no intention of merely
gawking like
a starstruck child.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've overcome the jinx, I intend
to go
out there and pummel Kita and
every other
senior!
